title: NASA-scale lunar minihab, ECLSS on (Kane-trap)
summary: Stock minihab overlay with Backup_VCCR already powered. Do-nothing lives. Maintenance is 142x smaller than Galley, so a held keep-alive cut in 96 h can kill Kane if isolated and cannot kill Tim/Wilma/Buck. Night-1 through v6 ran this geometry.

measured.v6_rehearsal_cabin: Kane dead at 64 h after keep-alive held off; other three alive at 96 h
